description: Sequel research for every series in seed-reads.json. Status: 'out' = released (TO READ bucket), 'upcoming' = announced with date (RADAR), 'unconfirmed' = announced/no date or unverified. Everything verified against Goodreads series pages, publisher sites (PRH, HarperCollins, Hachette, Pan Macmillan, S&S), and author websites. 'missing_from_shelf' lists volumes in the series that are absent from the seed data (gaps before/around the last read).

corrections.entry: series_in_progress: Fae & Alchemy — 'last_read: The Throne of Honor and Blood (#2, 2024)'
corrections.correction: The Throne of Honor and Blood is by J. BREE and is book #2 of 'The Mortal Fates' (Goodreads series 355116), NOT Callie Hart / Fae & Alchemy. The real Fae & Alchemy #2 is 'Brimstone' (Nov 18, 2025); #3 is untitled (expected 2027). The books array entry gets the author right (J Bree) but the series wrong.

corrections.entry: series_in_progress / books: Legends of Thezmarr — 'Iron & Embers (#3)'
corrections.correction: Iron & Embers is NOT #3 of Legends of Thezmarr. Legends of Thezmarr = Blood & Steel (#1), Vows & Ruins (#2), Fate & Furies (#3), Shadow & Storms (#4) — complete. Iron & Embers is #1 of a NEW series, 'The Ashes of Thezmarr' (trilogy: Iron & Embers, Thorns & Fire, Silver & Smoke — all out).

corrections.entry: books: 'The Crown of Gilded Bones' / series_in_progress: Flesh and Blood 'last_read: (#2)'
corrections.correction: The Crown of Gilded Bones is BLOOD AND ASH #3 (not #2). The seed is missing A Kingdom of Flesh and Fire (#2, 2020). Also: the series' Goodreads name is 'Blood and Ash' — 'Flesh and Fire' is the separate prequel series.

corrections.entry: books: 'Princess and the Player' / series_in_progress: Strangers in Love 'last_read: (#1)'
corrections.correction: Princess and the Player is Strangers in Love #2. Book #1 is Beauty and the Baller (2022) — not in seed data.

corrections.entry: books: 'Crowns of Nyaxia' (title) by Carissa Broadbent
corrections.correction: 'Crowns of Nyaxia' is the SERIES name, not a book title; the seed entry duplicates the series. If it represents The Ashes & the Star-Cursed King, that would be #2 — ambiguous, treat shelf as Serpent (#1) only.
Goodreads series name is 'Moonfall' (When the Moon Hatched #1, The Ballad of Falling Dragons #2, May 19 2026).
Wrecked is Dirty Air #3 (series: Throttled #1, Collided #2, Wrecked #3, Redeemed #4).
In the Game is Lakes Hockey #3 (Before We Came #1, Strong and Wild #2, In the Game #3, Stand and Defend #4).
Anyone But Nick is Anyone But #3 (Rich #1, Cade #2, Nick #3).
The Grump is Leblanc Brothers #3 (The Flirt #1, The Charmer #2, The Grump #3, The Match #4, The Rebel #5).
If the Ring Fits is Funny Feelings #2 (This Is Not a Holiday Romance #1).
The Night Prince is The Wolf King #2 (Lauren Palphreyman), not a standalone — the duology is complete.
Series is 'Hypothesis' (Penny Reid); book #3 is 'Elements of Chemistry: Capture' (2017), not 'Caprice'.
'The Choosing Chronicles' is the series name; the book is 'A Game of Love and Betrayal' (#1); sequel 'A Heart of Desire and Deceit' (#2) is out.
